page.title: Graphs
page.description: Design, run, and review agent workflows
page.empty_templates: Create a Graph with agents, branches, parallel work, and human approvals.
page.unavailable: This graph is unavailable or the server response could not be read.

editor.name: Name
editor.instructions_placeholder: Describe the work and the evidence this step must return.
editor.bindings_help: Use run_input, a prior node_output, constant or object. Paths use JSON Pointer, for example /requirements.
editor.invalid_json: Enter a valid JSON object for schemas and bindings.
editor.dirty: Save changes before validating or publishing.
editor.unsupported: This definition uses a schema or node type this client cannot edit.
editor.chain: Start → agent steps → human approval → end
editor.permission: Only the draft creator or a workspace administrator can edit. Publishing requires owner or admin.
editor.import_help: Import a complete V1 or V2 definition. Review and save the draft to update the server.
editor.imported: Definition imported; save to persist it.
editor.import_failed: Import failed; current edits were preserved.
editor.copy_failed: Copy failed. The exported JSON is available in the text field.

start.title: Start a run
start.no_version: Publish a version before starting a run.
start.fixed: The selected version, input and repository commit are fixed for this run.
start.runtime_support: Choose an online runtime that advertises Graph execution support. Existing agent runtime settings are preserved.

run.title: Graph run
run.reason_placeholder: Describe the decision or the resolved blocker.
run.no_controls: No action is currently available for your role and this run state.
run.execution_unknown: Execution has not been confirmed stopped. A replacement attempt cannot start yet.
run.cancel_pending: Cancellation requested. Waiting for execution to stop.
run.approval_help: Review the accepted node results and candidate digest before deciding. Your decision is bound to this exact candidate.
run.cancel_help: Active execution will be asked to stop. Late results will not advance this run.
run.graph_managed: This issue is managed by Graph. Execution and status changes are controlled from its run.

studio.title: Turn an idea into a workflow.
studio.description: Describe the outcome. AI will organize the steps, connect their inputs, and leave the final decision to you.
studio.placeholder: For example: research a feature request, turn the findings into an implementation plan, and send it to me for approval. Include the goal and what each step should deliver.
studio.review_hint: Creates an editable draft. Nothing runs or publishes automatically.
studio.queued: Waiting for the agent's runtime to take the task.
studio.running: The agent is drafting the workflow. This can take a few minutes.
studio.cancelled: Generation cancelled. Your description is unchanged.
studio.unavailable: AI generation has not been configured on this server. You can still build a workflow manually.
studio.replace_hint: AI proposes changes for you to review. Apply them explicitly, or discard the proposal to keep the current draft.
studio.example_research: Research a topic, summarize findings, then request my approval.
studio.example_release: Implement a change, verify the commit, then request release approval.
studio.example_content: Draft an article, review its facts and wording, then send it for approval.
studio.preview_title: From intent to a clear sequence
studio.preview_plan_hint: A goal and clear inputs for each step
studio.preview_work_hint: Each step hands its result to the next
studio.preview_review_hint: A person reviews the completed result
studio.preview_hint: Combine agents, conditional branches, parallel work, loops, and approval steps in one workflow.
studio.generated: Your draft is ready. Review the steps and save when you are happy with them.
studio.stale: Generation finished, but we kept your newer edits. Generate again to replace this draft.
studio.editor_hint: Connect nodes on the canvas and select a node to configure it. Open loops and subflows to edit their steps.
studio.empty_step: Describe the work this step should deliver.
studio.agent_hint: The selected agent will execute these steps. You can change the agent for each step in the draft.
studio.no_agents: No active agents are available. Add an agent or build the workflow manually.
studio.scope_hint: The workflow may use only these agents, and every step is assigned to one of them.
studio.cost_hint: Generation runs on the selected agent's runtime and uses its quota.
studio.error_busy: Another draft is being generated. Please try again shortly.
studio.error_timeout: Generation took too long. Your draft is unchanged; try a shorter description.
studio.error_failed: AI generation failed. Your draft is unchanged. Please try again.
studio.error_invalid: AI could not produce a valid workflow. Try describing the steps more clearly.
studio.error_capability: The selected agent's runtime cannot draft workflows yet. Update the Multica CLI on that machine, or choose another agent.
studio.error_agent: The selected agent is unavailable. Choose another agent.
studio.error_forbidden: You do not have permission to use the selected agent.
studio.retry_hint: Your description is kept, so you can try again right away.
studio.missing_agent: Choose an agent for every step before saving.
studio.missing_instructions: Add instructions for every step before saving.
studio.missing_approver: Choose a final approver before saving.

builder.setup_description: First choose which agent designs this workflow, which agents it may hand work to, and who approves it. After that you build the workflow turn by turn, and the canvas on the right follows along.
builder.start_failed: Could not start designing. Try again in a moment.
builder.send_failed: The message could not be sent. Try again.
builder.stop_failed: Could not stop the reply. Try again.
builder.executor_offline: This agent's runtime is offline, so it cannot design a workflow.
builder.executor_no_model: This agent has no model set, so it cannot design a workflow.
builder.recovery_hint: These conversations still exist, but the drafts they were writing are gone. Discarding one also deletes the carrier agent behind it.
builder.chat_hint: Say what should change and the canvas on the right follows.
builder.empty_description: Say what the goal is, what each step does and who runs it. Every reply redraws the whole graph on the right.
builder.canvas_hint: Changes from the conversation are merged here, and can be undone.
builder.footer_hint: When it looks right, open the editor to validate, save and publish.
builder.exit_confirm: The conversation is deleted. The draft it has drawn so far is kept.
builder.merge_unparsable: The draft in this reply is not valid JSON, so the canvas is unchanged. Asking it to "try again" works.
builder.merge_invalid: The draft in this reply is not a valid workflow, so the canvas is unchanged.
builder.merge_unknown_alias: This reply referred to a teammate that does not exist ({{alias}}), so the canvas is unchanged. Available teammates: {{available}}.
builder.merge_too_large: The draft in this reply is over the size limit, so the canvas is unchanged.

production.draft_recovered: Unsaved changes were recovered from this device.
production.draft_conflict: The saved graph changed while you were editing. Review the latest version before keeping your draft.
production.storage_conflict: Another tab saved a different local draft. Your changes are still here; choose which draft to keep.
production.storage_error: Local recovery is unavailable. Save or export your work before leaving.
production.proposal_stale: Your graph changed after this proposal. Generate a new proposal to preserve your edits.
production.search_issue: Search an issue by title or number
production.runtime_unavailable: No compatible online runtime. Update and connect an existing runtime.
production.unsupported: This graph uses a newer schema. Upgrade before editing.
production.replace_approver_help: Replacing an approver resets every vote for this approval gate. All assigned reviewers will need to review and vote again.
production.script_help: JavaScript receives input and returns output. Python receives input and assigns output. Send diagnostic logs to stderr.
production.manual_sha_help: This repository provider does not offer commit browsing here. Paste a full commit SHA; the runtime verifies that it exists in this repository.
production.unpriced_tasks: {{count}} tasks have no pricing data and are excluded from the reported cost.
production.http_retry_help: This request may already have changed the remote system. Inspect the remote result first, then record why another attempt is appropriate. Retrying may repeat an external effect if that system does not honor idempotency keys.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.cron_help: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. Example: 0 9 * * 1-5.
triggers.fixed_version: Triggers use the selected published version. Publishing a newer version does not update them automatically.
triggers.remove_help: Future events will stop starting runs. Existing runs are preserved.
triggers.rotate_help: The previous secret stops working immediately. Update every sender after rotation.
triggers.secret_once: Copy this secret now. It is shown only once and is not stored in the browser.
triggers.webhook_help: POST JSON {"input":{...}} with Authorization: Bearer <secret> and a unique Idempotency-Key for each event.
triggers.required: Complete the trigger name, title, and event settings.
